All Classes

  • All Classes Interface Summary Class Summary Exception Summary 
    Class Description
    BakeryApp
    Starts the Bakery Order Management System.
    BakeryOrderWindow
    The main window of the program and the only screen the user works with (the presentation layer).
    CakeLogo
    Draws the bakery's logo, a two-tier cake with a candle, using Java 2D.
    DailyReport
    The result of the custom action, the Daily Production Report.
    DataAccessException
    Signals a database problem, with a message written for the user.
    DatabaseConnector
    Connects the program to the user's MySQL database.
    InputCancelledException
    Thrown when the user types "cancel" at a prompt.
    InputEndedException
    Thrown when there is no more keyboard input to read.
    MySqlOrderRepository
    Stores orders in the orders table of a MySQL database (the data layer).
    Order
    One custom cake order, the object the whole system manages.
    OrderFileLoader
    Loads Order objects from a delimited text file.
    OrderManager
    Carries out every action on orders (the business logic layer).
    OrderRepository
    Describes what the program needs from its data storage: find, add, change and delete orders.
    OrderTableModel
    Supplies order data to the JTable in BakeryOrderWindow.
    OrderValidator
    Keeps every data rule in one place and cleans up what the user types.
    Theme
    The look of the program: colors, fonts and ready-styled Swing components.
